# Serve an auto-generated `llms.txt` on dbbat.com, and point instance `/llms.txt` at it

## Problem

There is no machine-readable entry point to the DBBat documentation. An agent (or a human
pasting a URL into one) that lands on `https://dbbat.com` or on a running DBBat instance
has to crawl the Docusaurus HTML to find out what DBBat is, which protocols it proxies, or
where the OpenAPI spec lives.

The [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) covers exactly this: a markdown file at the
site root listing the site's documentation as titled, annotated links, plus an optional
`llms-full.txt` containing the concatenated docs.

Two surfaces are in scope:

1. **The website** — `https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` must respond. Docusaurus builds to
   `website/build/` and is deployed to GitHub Pages by
   [.github/workflows/website.yml](.github/workflows/website.yml); anything at the build
   root is served as-is (`.txt` → `text/plain`). The file must be **generated at build
   time**, not hand-written: a hand-maintained `website/static/llms.txt` would silently rot
   the first time a doc page is added, renamed, or removed, which is the failure mode this
   whole idea is supposed to avoid.

2. **A DBBat instance** — `GET /llms.txt` on the API server currently 404s. Today the only
   root-level route is the `/` → `/app/` redirect in `setupFrontendRoutes()`
   ([internal/api/server.go:474](internal/api/server.go:474)); everything else lives under
   `/api/...` or `/app/*filepath`.

## Honest opinion

Worth doing, with two caveats. Read this before implementing — it changes the design.

**On llms.txt in general.** Adoption is real but shallow: no major model provider crawls
`llms.txt` the way search engines crawl `robots.txt`/`sitemap.xml`, so this will not
"make DBBat show up in ChatGPT". Its actual value is as a *paste-able URL* — you hand
`https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` to an agent and it gets a clean doc map instead of scraping
navbar chrome. That is a genuine but modest win. It is worth it **only because it is
auto-generated**: ~100 lines of build plugin, zero ongoing maintenance. If this required
hand-editing a file on every docs change, the honest recommendation would be to skip it.

**`llms-full.txt` is in scope, not optional** (confirmed 2026-08-02). In practice it is the
file that actually gets consumed — the index alone forces N follow-up fetches, and DBBat's
whole docs tree is ~20 files, small enough to concatenate into one document. Shipping only
`llms.txt` would deliver the less useful half of the convention and is not acceptable as a
partial implementation.

**On the instance side: serve a small local file, do not plain-redirect** (decided
2026-08-02 — the description's "refer / redirect" is settled as *refer*). A bare 302 to
`https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` is the weaker option because:

- DBBat instances are typically VPN-gated and often deployed where **outbound internet is
  restricted**. A client that can reach the instance may not be able to reach dbbat.com, so
  the redirect resolves to a timeout — strictly worse than the current 404, because it
  looks like it worked.
- A redirect throws away the only information the instance uniquely has: its **version**,
  its **OpenAPI spec URL**, and the fact that this is a specific deployment rather than the
  product website. That is exactly what an agent asking "how do I talk to this thing" needs.
- The generic docs are one hop away either way — a local file can *link* to
  `https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` as the canonical full index.

So: serve ~20 lines of instance-specific `text/plain` that links to the canonical file.
No config knob, no redirect mode — one behaviour.

**Non-goal:** no `robots.txt`, no `sitemap.xml` work, no SEO changes. Docusaurus already
emits a sitemap; this spec does not touch it.

## Proposal

### 1. Website — generate `llms.txt` + `llms-full.txt` at build time

Both files are required deliverables; the build must emit both or fail.

Add a **local Docusaurus plugin** at `website/plugins/llms-txt.ts`, imported and registered
from [website/docusaurus.config.ts](website/docusaurus.config.ts) alongside the existing
`@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects` entry. Do **not** add the third-party
`docusaurus-plugin-llms` dependency: the logic is small, and a new npm dep means permanent
Renovate churn ([.github/workflows/auto-update.yml](.github/workflows/auto-update.yml)) for
something we would rather own outright.

Plugin shape:

```ts
// website/plugins/llms-txt.ts
export default function llmsTxtPlugin(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: "llms-txt",
    async postBuild({ siteConfig, routesPaths, outDir }) { /* … */ },
  };
}
```

- **Source of truth:** walk `website/docs/**/*.{md,mdx}` from disk. For each file derive
  the URL the way Docusaurus does — `/docs/<path relative to docs/, extension stripped>`,
  `index` segments collapsed, `trailingSlash: false` (already set in the config). Take the
  title from the first `# ` heading (frontmatter has `sidebar_position` but no `title`/
  `description` today — see [website/docs/intro.md:1](website/docs/intro.md:1)) and the
  one-line annotation from the first non-empty paragraph after it, trimmed of markdown.
- **Rot guard (important):** `postBuild` receives `routesPaths`. Assert every generated
  URL is present in it and **throw** otherwise. That makes a renamed or deleted page a
  hard build failure instead of a silently dead link — this is what makes "auto-generated"
  actually mean something. The site already runs `onBrokenLinks: "throw"`, so failing the
  build here matches existing conventions.
- **Ordering:** group by top-level directory, ordered by the `_category_.json` /
  `sidebar_position` values already used by the autogenerated sidebar
  ([website/sidebars.ts](website/sidebars.ts)), so the file mirrors the site navigation.
- **`llms.txt` output** (per the convention): `# DBBat` H1, a `>` blockquote from
  `siteConfig.tagline`, a short prose paragraph, then `## Docs` / `## Configuration` /
  `## Installation` / `## API` sections of `- [Title](https://dbbat.com/…): annotation`
  links. Include an `## Optional` section linking `https://dbbat.com/llms-full.txt`, the
  GitHub repo, and `https://dbbat.com/docs/api`.
- **`llms-full.txt` output:** the same pages concatenated in the same order — frontmatter
  stripped, each preceded by a `# <Title>` heading and its canonical URL. Relative links
  between docs must be rewritten to absolute `https://dbbat.com/…` URLs, otherwise the
  concatenated file is full of links that resolve nowhere.
- Write both with `fs.writeFile` into `outDir`. No changes needed to
  [.github/workflows/website.yml](.github/workflows/website.yml) — it uploads
  `website/build` wholesale.

Verify with `cd website && bun run build && bun run serve`, then check
`http://localhost:3000/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt`. Confirm `bun run typecheck` still
passes (that script is currently green — see
[specs/done/2026/07/2026-07-03-document-httproute-website.md](specs/done/2026/07)).

### 2. Instance — `GET /llms.txt`

The endpoint returns **200 with a locally-rendered body**. It must not emit a 3xx to
dbbat.com under any circumstance — see the rationale above.

In [internal/api/server.go](internal/api/server.go), register a root-level route next to
the existing `/` redirect inside `setupFrontendRoutes()` (~line 474). `/` is an exact
route, not a wildcard, so `/llms.txt` introduces no gin routing conflict; the `/app/*filepath`
wildcard is unaffected.

Serve `text/plain; charset=utf-8`, unauthenticated, roughly:

```
# DBBat (this instance)

> Transparent database proxy for PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL/MariaDB and MongoDB.
> Every query logged, every connection tracked, access granted for a limited time.

This is a running DBBat instance, version <build version>.

## This instance
- [Web UI](/app/)
- [OpenAPI spec](/api/openapi.yml)
- [API reference (Swagger UI)](/api/docs)
- [Version info](/api/v1/version)

## Documentation
- [Full documentation index](https://dbbat.com/llms.txt)
- [Full documentation text](https://dbbat.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Website](https://dbbat.com)
```

Notes:

- Version comes from `version.Version` — already exposed unauthenticated via
  `/api/v1/version` ([internal/api/server.go:180](internal/api/server.go:180)), so this
  leaks nothing new. **Do not** include listen addresses, public endpoints, or enabled
  proxies: `/api/v1/instance` is authenticated for a reason, and an unauthenticated
  `/llms.txt` must not become a side channel for the instance topology.
- Emit relative links for instance-local paths so it works behind any hostname/proxy.
  Respect `s.config.BaseURL` for the UI link rather than hardcoding `/app`.
- Add a handler unit test in `internal/api/` asserting 200, the `text/plain` content type,
  no auth required, and presence of the canonical `https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` link.

### 3. Docs

Mention `/llms.txt` in the website docs — a short paragraph in
[website/docs/api/index.md](website/docs/api/index.md) noting that both dbbat.com and every
instance expose one, and what an agent should fetch first.

## Open questions

- Should `llms-full.txt` also inline the OpenAPI spec (`internal/api/openapi.yml`)? It
  would make the file self-sufficient for an agent writing API calls, but roughly doubles
  its size. Recommendation: link it, do not inline it.
- No GitHub issue exists for this yet — one should be filed if it is not picked up soon.

## Implementation Plan

### 1. Instance endpoint — `GET /llms.txt` (`internal/api/server.go`)

- Add `handleLLMsTxt` next to `handleVersion`/`handleOpenAPISpec` (~line 380): renders a
  `text/plain; charset=utf-8` body from a `%s`-templated const, filling in `version.Version`
  and the configured `s.config.BaseURL` (default `/app`). No DB, no auth.
- Register `router.GET("/llms.txt", s.handleLLMsTxt)` in `setupFrontendRoutes()` right after
  the existing `/` → base-URL redirect (~line 493). `/` is exact, so no gin conflict with
  `/app/*filepath`.
- Body omits listen addresses, enabled proxies, and any other `/api/v1/instance`-only field
  — links only `/app/`, `/api/openapi.yml`, `/api/docs`, `/api/v1/version`, plus the
  `https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` canonical links.
- Test: `internal/api/llms_txt_test.go`, calling `handleLLMsTxt` directly via
  `gin.CreateTestContext` (pattern already used by `TestParseUIDParam` in
  `server_test.go`) — no router/DB needed. Asserts 200, `text/plain` content type, presence
  of the canonical `https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` links, that `BaseURL` is
  respected, and that no listen-address/port strings leak into the body.

### 2. Website plugin — `website/plugins/llms-txt.ts`

- New local Docusaurus plugin, `postBuild({ siteConfig, routesPaths, outDir })`:
  1. Walk `website/docs/**/*.{md,mdx}` from disk (skip `.DS_Store` and any non-md/mdx file).
  2. For each file: strip frontmatter, derive the site URL Docusaurus-style
     (`/docs/<relative path, extension stripped>`, `index` segment collapsed,
     `trailingSlash: false`), pull the title from the first `# ` heading (or frontmatter
     `title:` where a `# ` heading isn't present — needed for `docs/changelog.md`, which is
     an MDX import wrapper with no in-file `# `), and the annotation from the first
     non-empty paragraph after the heading, markdown-stripped to one line.
  3. **`docs/changelog.md` special case:** the file's body is just
     `import Changelog from '../../CHANGELOG.md'; <Changelog />` — not prose. Detect this
     file by path and, instead of parsing it as a normal doc, read the repo-root
     `CHANGELOG.md` directly for both the annotation (first paragraph after its own `#
     Changelog` heading — practically the latest release line) and, in `llms-full.txt`, the
     full changelog body (relative links inside it, if any, get the same rewrite pass).
  4. Order pages by `_category_.json` `position` (directory grouping) then `sidebar_position`
     within a directory, matching the autogenerated sidebar
     (`{ type: "autogenerated", dirName: "." }` in `sidebars.ts`).
  5. **Rot guard:** after building the URL list, assert every one is included in
     `routesPaths` (passed into `postBuild`); `throw` with the offending path(s) if not —
     hard build failure, not a warning.
  6. Emit `llms.txt`: `# DBBat` H1, `>` blockquote of `siteConfig.tagline`, a short prose
     line, then `## Docs` / `## Installation` / `## Configuration` / `## API` sections
     (grouped by top-level dir, `intro.md` and `performance.md`/`security.md` root docs
     under `## Docs`) of `- [Title](https://dbbat.com/<url>): annotation` links, plus an
     `## Optional` section linking `https://dbbat.com/llms-full.txt`, the GitHub repo, and
     `https://dbbat.com/docs/api`.
  7. Emit `llms-full.txt`: same ordering, each doc as `# <Title>` + canonical URL comment +
     body with frontmatter stripped; relative markdown links (`(/docs/...)`,
     `(./foo.md)`, `(../bar.md)`) rewritten to absolute `https://dbbat.com/...`. Links the
     OpenAPI spec (`https://dbbat.com/api/openapi.yml` is instance-local, so link
     `internal/api/openapi.yml` on GitHub) rather than inlining it, per the spec's decided
     open question.
  8. Write both via `fs.writeFile(path.join(outDir, "llms.txt"|"llms-full.txt"), …)`; let
     any write error propagate (fails the build).
- Register the plugin in `website/docusaurus.config.ts`, in the existing `plugins: [...]`
  array alongside `@docusaurus/plugin-client-redirects`, as a local import
  (`import llmsTxtPlugin from "./plugins/llms-txt"`), not a string package name.

### 3. Docs — `website/docs/api/index.md`

- Short paragraph (near the top, after "Base URL" or near "OpenAPI Specification") noting
  both `https://dbbat.com/llms.txt` and every running instance's `/llms.txt` exist, and that
  an agent should fetch the instance's own `/llms.txt` first (it links onward to the full
  docs) rather than assuming dbbat.com is reachable.

### 4. QA

- `go build ./...`, `go test ./internal/api/... -run TestHandleLLMsTxt`,
  `golangci-lint run ./internal/api/...` — done incrementally per commit.
- `cd website && bun run typecheck && bun run build` — inspect
  `website/build/llms.txt` and `website/build/llms-full.txt` for real content and no
  unrewritten relative links. Exercise the rot guard by reasoning about / temporarily
  breaking a URL and confirming the build throws, then revert.
- Full gate once: `make lint && make test` (Go side changed) plus the website build above.
- Final commit: `chore: all checks passing for Serve an auto-generated llms.txt`.

### Status at time of writing

Step 1 (instance endpoint + test) is implemented and committed. Step 2 (website plugin) and
step 3 (docs paragraph) are next.
